tools.name: search_sneakers
tools.description: Search the catalogue by model name, colorway or manufacturer style code (e.g. "samba og", "HQ9438"). Returns products with their live lowest price and how many tracked retailers carry each.

tools.name: where_to_buy
tools.description: Every tracked retailer currently carrying a product, with each one's price, in-stock sizes and a direct link to its own product page. This is the long-tail coverage a feed-based catalogue does not have.

tools.name: cheapest_for_size
tools.description: For one product, the cheapest retailer holding EACH size. The winning store differs size to size, so a product-level "lowest price" is usually the wrong answer for a specific buyer.

tools.name: list_brands
tools.description: Brands in the catalogue with product counts. Ground a brand name before searching.
